reasons.organs_overview -> brain: The overview defines what an organ is and places the brain on the body map, which the brain section then builds on.
reasons.organs_overview -> heart: A learner needs the idea of an organ as a body part with a special job, and where the chest organs sit, before studying the heart's job.
reasons.organs_overview -> lungs: The overview's definition of an organ and its body map come before the details of what the lungs do.
reasons.organs_overview -> stomach: The stomach section assumes the learner already knows what an organ is and that the stomach is one of the major organs in the belly.
reasons.organs_overview -> liver: The liver section assumes the general idea of an organ and its place among the major organs on the body map.
reasons.organs_overview -> kidneys: The kidneys section assumes the learner knows what an organ is and that the kidneys are among the major organs near the back.
reasons.organs_overview -> bones_muscles: The overview lists bones and muscles as major organs, which frames the section on what bones and muscles do.
reasons.stomach -> intestines: The small intestine breaks food down 'even more', so the learner must first know that the stomach mashes food into a paste.
reasons.bones_muscles -> protective_bones_figure: The figure shows specific bones (skull, ribs) protecting organs, which needs the idea that some bones protect soft organs.
reasons.brain -> protective_bones_figure: To see why the skull wraps around the brain, the learner must know the brain is a soft, important organ inside the head.
reasons.heart -> protective_bones_figure: The rib cage figure shows the heart inside the ribs, so the learner must already know what the heart is and where it sits.
reasons.lungs -> protective_bones_figure: The rib cage figure shows the lungs inside the ribs, so the learner must already know what the lungs are and where they are.
reasons.brain -> organs_summary: The summary table recalls the brain's place and job, which only makes sense after the brain section.
reasons.heart -> organs_summary: The summary table recalls the heart's place and job, so the heart section must come first.
reasons.lungs -> organs_summary: The summary table recalls the lungs' place and job, so the lungs section must come first.
reasons.intestines -> organs_summary: The summary table recalls where the intestines are and what they do, so the intestines section must come first.
reasons.liver -> organs_summary: The summary table recalls the liver's place and its bile and blood-cleaning jobs, so the liver section must come first.
reasons.kidneys -> organs_summary: The summary table recalls the kidneys' place and their job of making urine, so the kidneys section must come first.
reasons.bones_muscles -> organs_summary: The summary table recalls what bones and muscles do, so the bones and muscles section must come first.
